system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: Namaste, can you help me? Perform these two different actions simultaneously: agrimarket_update_listing and agrimarket_track_delivery. Here are my details: my listing_id is None, my order_id is dummy_order_id_9281.

function.name: agrimarket_update_listing
function.description: Updates an existing listing (price, quantity, status). Only the creator can modify. Requires session_token. Does NOT create new listings. Fails if listing_id is invalid, user is not owner, or listing is deleted.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all transactional tools.

function.name: agrimarket_track_delivery
function.description: Tracks delivery status for dispatched orders. Delivery tracking exists only after dispatch. Requires session_token. Does NOT modify delivery. Fails if order is not yet dispatched.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all transactional tools.
